bead.title: Canonicalize bootstrap and README Databricks examples
bead.description: PROBLEM: The bootstrap-facing docs teach mixed dialect spelling, which leaves Databricks users unsure whether they should pass `spark` or `databricks`. ROOT CAUSE: `docs/guide/bootstrap.md:18` tells Databricks/Spark bootstrap users to pass `dialect="spark"`, and `README.md:144-149` shows `bootstrap_from_tables` without any dialect guidance, so the canonical alias is not taught consistently. PROPOSED FIX: Update the bootstrap guide, README examples, and Databricks notebook/try-it-out docs to use `dialect="databricks"` where that is the public Databricks-facing spelling, and explain that internal emitters may normalize to `spark` when the SQL is identical. NON-SCOPE: One-shot bootstrap facade implementation. Production pipeline JSON/wheel packaging contract. Inline UMF format cleanup. No broad documentation rewrite outside Databricks dialect guidance. GOVERNING ARTIFACTS: `docs/guide/bootstrap.md:10`; `README.md:139`; `docs/helix/03-test/conformance-acceptance.md:109`; `scripts/run_integration_tests_databricks.ipynb`. DEPENDENCIES: `tablespec-ed74497c`.
bead.acceptance:
1. TestBootstrapDocsUseDatabricksAlias: add a docs traceability regression that scans `docs/guide/bootstrap.md`, `README.md`, and `scripts/run_integration_tests_databricks.ipynb` for canonical Databricks wording and the Spark-family alias explanation.
2. TestNoBootstrapDocRequiresSparkOnly: assert no public bootstrap example instructs Databricks users to pass only `dialect="spark"` unless the sentence explicitly explains internal Spark-family normalization.
3. go test ./...
4. lefthook run pre-commit.
